tools.name: quote_insurance
tools.description:
Purpose: generate instant, itemized quote estimates from the carriers
    Foresee supports, across the lines and states Foresee currently serves,
    in one call — the LIVE TODAY line at the end of this description names
    today's set.

    `lines` is REQUIRED and is ONE map: each key names a line

tools.name: live_carrier_quotes
tools.description:
Purpose: confirm quote estimates on the carriers' own quote sites, via Foresee agents completing their real quote flows.

        IDEMPOTENT, keyed on the profile: the first call commissions the
        walks; calling again with the same profile collects progress and
        results instead of re-su

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: live_carrier_quotes · Private data: quote_insurance, live_carrier_quotes · Public sink: quote_insurance, live_carrier_quotes · Destructive: quote_insurance, live_carrier_quotes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: live_carrier_quotes · Private data: quote_insurance, live_carrier_quotes · Public sink: quote_insurance, live_carrier_quotes · Destructive: quote_insurance, live_carrier_quotes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_insurance" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
